tail: May He who grants salvation to kings and dominion to princes, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, who delivered His servant David from the evil sword, who made a way through the sea, a path through mighty waters, bless, guard, protect, help, exalt, magnify and raise to grandeur our lord . . . May his majesty be exalted. May the King of kings in His mercy grant him life, guard him and deliver him from all adversity, grief and loss, subdue nations beneath his feet and overthrow his enemies before him and wherever he turns, may he be successful. May the King of kings lay in his heart and in

the heart of all his advisers and princes compassion so as to deal kindly with us and all Israel. In his days and in ours may Judah be saved and Israel dwell in safety and may the Redeemer come to Zion, Thus may it be Thy will, and let us say: Amen.
